eps.o: Allura's extravagant Scorpio Ball promises a night of glamour, but an uninvited enemy threatens to bring out everyone's stingers. Meanwhile, a high-stakes divorce case puts Emerald and Liberty to the test.
A trip to scatter Dina's husband's ashes takes a harrowing turn when the women encounter trouble at 30,000 feet. Meanwhile, Allura's new bodyguard proves to be more than just a pretty face.
A Thanksgiving divorce dispute forces the ladies to trade their holiday plans for a feast at the firm. But as old wounds reopen and new secrets nearly spill, the holiday comes to a violent halt.
As the women grapple with the aftermath of the Thanksgiving from Hell, a shocking secret threatens to change everything.
